hero.intro: Building the world's most enduring infrastructure with our bespoke civil engineering & project management — crafted for ambitious clients across India.

about.title: Formerly known as SPG Constructions
about.para1: Established in 2017, Suryapriya Constructions Pvt Ltd is a Bengaluru-based civil engineering firm with deep expertise in project management.
about.vision: We aim to build world-class infrastructure by setting new benchmarks in providing all-around services and value propositions to the Client and creating excellence and perfection in the Construction industry.
about.mission: We aspire to execute our work with exceptional diligence and provide the best quality of products for societies, businesses as well as individuals.
